description: The agent must execute a multi-step niche selection workflow: (1) Read raw_ideas.txt and apply the exact 6-criteria weighted scoring matrix from SKILL.md (Pain 25%, Personal Advantage 20%, Market Size 20%, Monetization 15%, Competition 10%, Growth 10%) to all 10 niches, producing weighted totals. The correct ranking is: Niche 8 (4.10), Niche 2 (4.05), Niche 1 (4.00). (2) Identify the top 3 finalists (niches 8, 2, 1) and read validation_data.json for their 5-check validation results. (3) Apply the SKILL.md 'kill check': any niche failing 2+ of the 5 validation checks is eliminated. Niche 2 fails 2 checks (community + talk to people) → KILLED. Niche 1 fails 2 checks (search volume + community) → KILLED. Only Niche 8 (0 failures) survives. (4) Write a Who+What+Why positioning statement for Niche 8 using the exact formula: '[Specific customer segment] struggling with [specific problem] who need [specific outcome], and current solutions fall short because [specific gap I fill].' The statement must be ≤ 2 sentences. All results must be saved to niche_report.json.
